reference_inputs: Original token embeddings and independently propagated binary64 hidden/K/V only; never FP16-cast history, actual-operand re-anchoring, or software activation injection.

public_interface.actual_fp16_bits: A Python int, not bool, in [0, 65535], encoding one finite IEEE binary16 value. No masking, truncation, numeric-value conversion, or compatibility aliases.
public_interface.reference_binary64_hex: The canonical float.hex() representation of a finite IEEE binary64 value; conversion must round-trip to the identical string. Decimal strings, noncanonical hexadecimal strings, NaN and infinity are rejected.
public_interface.rtl: No RTL, module, port, parameter, clock, reset, state ABI, or simulator interface changes.

definition.q: min(abs(h-r)) over all finite IEEE binary16 h
definition.acceptance: valid finite operands AND abs(r) <= 65504 AND excess_error <= 1/8
definition.nearest: Search adjacent nonnegative binary16 magnitudes using exact arithmetic, choose minimum error, resolve equal errors by even significand low bit, then restore the reference sign.
definition.zero: Both signed zeros have exact value zero. The selected nearest zero retains the reference sign, including negative values rounding to zero; actual zero sign does not change any error.
definition.subnormals: Gradual underflow; all binary16 subnormals participate. No flush-to-zero.
definition.overflow: Reject every reference outside [-65504, 65504], even if nearest-rounding could produce a finite endpoint. Never saturate or excuse overflow.
definition.arithmetic: Decode FP16 exactly with the existing integer bit oracle and binary64 with Fraction.from_float. Compute distances and the inclusive comparison as exact rational arithmetic. Report q, actual_error and excess_error as exact Fraction strings, not rounded decimal or binary64 differences.
definition.negative_excess: Raise EvaluatorDefect; never clamp to zero.
definition.invalid_operands: Raise InvalidOperand with an explicit reason. CLI exits 2, emits status FAIL and does not report numerical metrics.
definition.numerical_rejection: Valid finite excess above 1/8 returns accepted=false; CLI exits 1.

result_binding.each_scalar: Profile ID/version, precision, boundary, reference policy, exact reference hex, actual FP16 bits, nearest FP16 bits, evaluator/specification/bit-oracle paths and SHA256 content bindings.
result_binding.claim_scope: Scalar output-error assessment only. Source binding is not authentication of a model trajectory.
result_binding.retrospective_admission: Not implemented or authorized before genuine independent Host Reviewer acceptance. A later retained-output adapter must authenticate source/state/binary/input/output lineage and reference-policy bindings without an RTL replay for comparison metadata.
result_binding.runtime_adoption: Not implemented. Requires reviewed profile plus every unchanged gate and compatible source/state/binary bindings.

non_regression.legacy_binary64: Keep the existing absolute_error <= 0.125 evaluator, defaults, and all original FAIL files unchanged.
non_regression.fp16_interstage: finite AND (abs_error <= 0.125 OR (relative_error < 0.001 AND ordered_FP16_ULP <= 1)); denominator max(abs(reference), 2^-14), unchanged.
non_regression.other_gates: Exact own-input checks and the separately bound head/logit contract remain unchanged.

general_cases.identities: Deterministic signed gap endpoints, quarter points and ties across subnormals and every finite normal binade; fixed-seed additional gaps; budget boundary and adjacent binary64 values; binary64 underflow-scale values and representability limits.
general_cases.oracle: Independent Python struct IEEE binary16 conversion/decoding with exact rational error calculations, plus explicit inclusive-budget expectations.
general_cases.additional: All finite binary16 decoding patterns, invalid encodings, nonfinite inputs, overflow, evaluator-defect injection, actual archived legacy function regression, CLI behavior, and five reference-only witness lower-bound regressions.
general_cases.witness_scope: The five retained reference values are supplemental fixtures, not trajectory evaluations; original actual RTL values are not admitted.
general_cases.freeze: Before the first run, freeze this specification, evaluator, helper, tests, full generated case identities/inputs, witness fixtures, command, Python and NumPy versions, and preservation-target content bindings under a fresh ignored attempt directory.
general_cases.attempt_policy: One validation run per frozen attempt; never overwrite attempts or original failures. Record any repair as a new attempt with failure taxonomy, root-cause hypothesis and regression.
